text:
marta-partners: FYI OrbitalEdge raised a hard stop — Marketplace PO is blocked by a delivery SLA clause that conflicts with their MSA. They say the shipping window collapsed for the on-prem GPU rack (weird timing). PO# OE-2026.
lyra-procure: seeing the same in the portal: error says `Delivery SLA conflicts with MSA: 'on-prem delivery window (30d) vs partner SLA (60d)'.` Portal screenshot attached in email. No way to progress signing from partner side.
jess-ops: opened internal ticket and pinged Marketplace support. Ticket ID: PO-7441. Also created partner escalation to OrbitalEdge AM.
partner_ops_bot: Created case PO-7441 and routed to marketplace-integrations@redwood.com. ETA initial response: 4h.
liam-legal: skimmed the redline. OrbitalEdge replaced our standard delivery clause with a non-standard "ordered-by-window" obligation that effectively makes us accept 60d shipment guarantee. That's risky for on-prem hardware. Can we push back to a performance-based window or carve out force majeure for supply chain?
kyler-sales: partner says their shipping is usually 45-75 days for H100 racks. They want the marketplace flow to lock the PO now or they'll require a direct SOW. Sales prefers to keep it in marketplace for seat allocation and reporting. Can we split: marketplace for reservation + direct SO for final delivery terms?
marta-partners: splitting might work. Marketplace can accept a reservation PO (no delivery SLA) and we track delivery via partner SOW. Question: can marketplace portal accept a "reservation only" PO status? @jess-ops any precedence?
jess-ops: we have one precedent earlier (Partner: NebulaEdge) where we used a reservation flow but required manual reconciliation in our billing pipeline. It wasn't ideal but worked. We'll need an ops runbook step + invoice mapping.
sally-eng: technical note — if they delay full shipment beyond 60 days we need to flag compatibility/firmware drift risk. Also rack assembly & testing takes extra 5-7 days. Lead time for 8x H100 nodes is real.
liam-legal: quick proposal: accept reservation PO in marketplace, append a short addendum for final delivery SOW to be executed on shipment confirmation. Add indemnity cap language: mutual cap of $500k and force majeure explicitly covering semiconductor shortages.
kyler-sales: propose we offer the partner a 60d target as an operational goal but keep legal redline as negotiated (addendum). If partner refuses, escalate to AM manager. We need internal signoff by EOD for launch cadence.
marta-partners: next steps: (1) jess-ops confirm marketplace supports reservation flow and draft ops runbook (owner: jess-ops, due: 2026-03-24 10:00 PT) (2) liam-legal to draft a 1-paragraph addendum and indemnity language (owner: liam-legal, due: 2026-03-24 14:00 PT) (3) kyler-sales to ask OrbitalEdge if they'll accept reservation + SOW split or insist on direct SOW (owner: kyler-sales, due: 2026-03-23 COB) (4) sally-eng to provide hardware lead-time note and compatibility checklist (owner: sally-eng, due: 2026-03-24 12:00 PT).
liam-legal: I'll draft the addendum and ping OrbitalEdge counsel. If they bargain up indemnity we should escalate to VP Legal.
jess-ops: confirmed marketplace portal can tag a PO as "reservation" but finance needs manual mapping for revenue recognition. I'll open a finance sync and cc @marta-partners.
marta-partners: thanks all — will keep partner on warm-hold. If anyone hears friction from OrbitalEdge AM escalate to me directly. :thumbsup:
kyler-sales: pinged AM, they replied "we can accept reservation for APAC shipments but EU/NA will need direct SOWs due to logistics." So we may need per-region handling.
jess-ops: noted per-region branching in runbook. I'll include that in the initial draft.
marta-partners: summary: reservation flow accepted as workaround, legal addendum in progress, per-region finalization pending. Meeting if things stall tomorrow 09:00 PT. :calendar:
